name: VAST Data
h1: VAST Data ARR: $500M+ of Committed Revenue Powering AI Factories.
intro: VAST Data built the storage layer for AI factories — the systems that keep tens of thousands of GPUs fed with data — and crossed $500M of committed ARR on the way to a $30B valuation. Every reported ARR, bookings and funding number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How Committed Storage Contracts Reached $500M ARR.
modelParagraphs: VAST sells software-defined storage as a subscription: a unified platform for unstructured data (file, object, database) licensed by capacity, deployed on customers' hardware. The AI boom changed the demand curve — every 'AI factory' running thousands of GPUs needs storage that can feed them, and VAST positioned itself as the data layer for those builds, particularly through its deep NVIDIA partnership in AI factory reference architectures.

The metric VAST leads with is committed ARR — contracted recurring revenue, which reached $500M+ in 2026 alongside ~$4B in cumulative bookings and $2B+ in cumulative revenue. The gap between committed and recognized is timing: large multi-year deployments get booked upfront and recognized over the contract. A ~$1B Series F at a $30B valuation — NVIDIA among the backers — marked the jump from $9.1B in December 2023.
revenueMix: Software licenses billed by capacity on customer hardware, the core recurring line.
Large multi-year deployments co-sold through the NVIDIA AI factory ecosystem.
Enterprise support bundled into committed contracts.

faqs.q: What Is VAST Data's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: VAST Data reports over $500 million in committed ARR as of 2026, up from $200M in early 2025. Committed ARR is contracted recurring revenue — alongside ~$4B in cumulative bookings and $2B+ in cumulative revenue.

faqs.q: What Does 'Committed ARR' Mean for VAST?
faqs.a: It counts contracted recurring revenue, not yet-recognized revenue. Large multi-year deployments are booked when signed and recognized over the contract term, so committed ARR runs ahead of recognized revenue — the basis note on VAST's figure reflects exactly this.

faqs.q: How Fast Did VAST Data Grow?
faqs.a: From $200M ARR in early 2025 — with a $1B annual order rate in Q1 2025 — to $500M+ of committed ARR roughly a year later, hitting its projection to triple ARR within a year.

A ~$1B Series F (primary and secondary, ~$1B total transaction value) valued VAST at $30 billion, up from $9.1B in December 2023. NVIDIA is a backer, and the round was reportedly the largest private financing in Israeli tech history.

Enterprises and AI infrastructure operators building large-scale GPU clusters — including neoclouds and AI factories built around NVIDIA reference architectures — where VAST's shared-everything storage platform feeds data to tens of thousands of accelerators.
